paragraphs: Save Fuel Europe SAS is the sole distributor in France for Fuel Ox.  This is a fuel treatment that was developed over 30 years ago for the AT&T company and the US military.

Fuel Ox improves fuel consumption. Before establishing Save Fuel Europe SAS, Fuel Ox was tested using a 2005 Land Cruiser with a D4D turbo diesel engine and found a 22% fuel saving. This gave us confidence to bring Fuel Ox to France. Land Cruiser test report
Independent road tests were also done in France. The lowest reduction in fuel consumption was 9%. The test report is available here.

As an example, for a truck driving 150,000 km/year and burning 45,000 L of fuel, a 9% reduction saves 4050 litres.  At a treatment cost per litre of €0.0198 and fuel cost of €2 per litre, €7209 would be saved.

paragraphs: Test your fuel reduction for free.
At Save Fuel Europe, we offer a free trial to see for yourself the savings you can make before you buy.

We provide you with the amount of Fuel Ox needed to carry out this test in real conditions. For reliable results, we recommend using a vehicle that refuels at least twice a week and is usually driven in similar conditions.
How does the trial work?  The trial is simply carried out in three stages:
steps: Start by refuelling (always at the same level to ensure accuracy). Write down your mileage and then use the vehicle normally. On the next fill-up, note the mileage and the amount of fuel added again. This will give you your reference consumption.
Then add Fuel Ox (starting dose) and continue to use your vehicle normally. This phase allows the fuel system to be gradually cleaned and its performance to be optimised.
After this phase, continue with the normal dose of Fuel Ox. Read your consumption data again to easily compare with your initial results.

manufacturers-guarantee.title: Manufacturer's guarantee
manufacturers-guarantee.p1_1: Fuel Ox carries insurance for up to US$ 2,000,000 in case of damage to an engine caused by Fuel Ox treatment. No claim was ever made. No user has ever alleged that using Fuel Ox damaged their engine.

EN590-ASTM-950.title: EN590 and ASTM-D975 compliance guarantees
EN590-ASTM-950.p1_1: Laboratory tests completed by Intertek in France compared untreated diesel with diesel treated with twice the normal concentration of Fuel Ox. Most measurements were the same, 7 showed tiny differences. The treated fuel remains compliant with the EN590 specification. The lab report also notes that treated Red Diesel also remains within specification. Fuel Ox presence cannot be detected by testing to EN590. Engine warranty remains valid because the fuel meets the required specification. See the France Intertek lab EN590 tests.
EN590-ASTM-950.p1_2: See the France Intertek lan EN590 tests.
EN590-ASTM-950.p2: Comparative lab tests to the US standard ASTM-D975 also showed that treated fuel results were almost identical and met the standard.

save-fuel-europe-guarantee.p1: Our own and many independent tests prove that Fuel Ox treatment cuts vehicle fuel consumption from 6% up to 28%. Test reports are on the Vehicles page. The lowest saving from independent tests in France showed a 9% reduction in fuel consumption.

direct-cost-benefit.p1: A typical well maintained 100 kVA generator at 75% full load would burn around 21 L/hour, providing ~ 3.6 kWh/L. If that was used over 22 x 8 hour working days in a month, untreated fuel used would be 21 x 8 x 22 = 3696 L. At 9% cut in consumption, this saves 332 L

history.title: History
history.p1: Bell Labs is an American scientific and industrial research laboratory established in 1925. It developed radio astronomy, transistors, lasers, photovoltaic cells, the charge coupled device, information theory, the Unix computer operating system and several major programming languages. Its researchers were awarded eleven Nobel prizes and five Turing Awards for research done at Bell Labs, including for the discovery of the Cosmic Microwave Background.
history.p2: Molecules of hydrocarbon fuels are polar. They have different electrical charges at different places on the molecule. This leads to polymerisation, where negative charges on one molecule stick to positive charges on another molecule. This causes clumps of molecules to form, which prevents oxygen reaching the molecules inside the clump during combustion. Incomplete combustion causes soot and unburnt hydrocarbons at the exhaust and requires more fuel to create a given power output. More throttle is needed to maintain the same power. Polymerisation increases with time so that after several months from production in a refinery, fuel becomes unusable. It plugs filters and fuel lines and creates deposits inside injection systems. Engines become less efficient with use, which means even more fuel must be burned for a desired performance.
history.p3: Bell Labs was owned by the huge AT&T company (Atlantic Telephone and Telegraph), which had a large fleet of vehicles across the USA. The labs developed a fuel treatment to break up and prevent fuel polymerisation, restoring engine performance and fuel combustion to improve storage life and reduce fuel consumption. This fuel treatment was then adopted by the US military. Its current name is Fuel Ox and it currently treats around 50 million litres of fuel a month, mostly in the USA.
history.p4: Fuel Ox includes catalysts. A catalyst causes chemical reactions without being consumed by the reaction, so a small amount of catalyst will keep working over a long time. The normal treatment with Fuel Ox uses one part in 10,000. One litre of Fuel Ox treats 10,000 litres of fuel. Our vehicle test showed improved combustion efficiency of about 5%. The improvement in engine efficiency can be much greater, depending on the state of the engine.

about.title: Save Fuel Europe is the exclusive Fuel Ox distributor in France
about.p1: We support transport, delivery, logistics companies and off-grid power users in reducing their fuel bills with a simple, efficient and engine-safe solution.
about.p2: Do you manage a fleet of commercial vehicles, trucks or generators and see fuel costs eroding your margins month after month? You know that a significant discount would make all the difference, but you're hesitant to trust a distributor that's still relatively unknown in France?
about.p3: We fully understand this caution. Vehicle and generator fleet managers are primarily concerned with two things: avoiding any risk to expensive engines and managing operating costs.
about.p4: Save Fuel Europe is a small team of professionals. Without a large head office or flashy marketing, we focus on the essentials: a close, transparent and results-oriented service.
about.p5: We chose to start modestly to build real credibility with our clients. Our ambition is to provide long-term support to road transport companies, ski resorts, fleet managers and off-grid power users in France and Europe, helping them improve both their financial performance and their environmental footprint.
about.p6: As the exclusive distributor in France, we are committed to providing personalized support and quality service to all our customers.
